slides.title: Start the connector again
slides.html: Open a terminal, type odmdm-connector web and press Enter: the connector's page opens in your browser. If it does not open, open the address the terminal shows.

slides.title: Token not kept?
slides.html: Without Remember on this computer, the connector asks for the token at every start. Paste it and press Connect.

slides.title: Every batch starts the same
slides.html: Open enrolment and press Open in the MDM connector. Every opening makes a new challenge, so hand it over before the phones ask.

slides.title: Use the new settings
slides.html: In the connector's new tab, press Use the new settings. Your MDM then has the new challenge.

slides.title: Watch the clock
slides.html: The line at the top says until when phones are accepted, and turns amber ten minutes before. A phone that asks after closing is refused.

slides.title: A phone is replaced or wiped
slides.html: Enrol the phone and give it a new callsign: Deploy App gives no callsign twice. A wiped phone can come back under its old one: give it a new one too.

slides.title: A phone is renamed
slides.html: Select it and press Give callsigns. The old callsign keeps working until it is removed in Deploy App: the connector says which one.

slides.title: Remove the old callsign
slides.html: In Deploy App open User Management, then Manage Users, choose the old callsign, press Remove and type the callsign to confirm.

slides.title: Certificates end
slides.html: A phone's certificate lasts as long as your Deploy App's certificates do: at most three months today. Before it ends, give the phone a new callsign and remove the old one, as above.

slides.title: Change the token
slides.html: With Fleet, press Settings, then Change the Fleet settings. Settings also shows where the connector's log is.

slides.title: Give the new token
slides.html: Press Next on Fleet address, paste the new token on API token, press Next and then Connect.

slides.title: Changed the address or team?
slides.html: A kept token works only with the settings it was kept for. After changing Fleet's address or the team, type the token again.

slides.title: Another Deploy App
slides.html: The name at the top right lists your Deploy Apps, and + Add a Deploy App adds one. With Fleet, each needs a Fleet of its own: see One Fleet, one Deploy App in Set Fleet up for Deploy App.

slides.title: Remove a Deploy App
slides.html: In the same list, Remove north.example.fi… asks first, then forgets that Deploy App and its token on this computer. Nothing changes in Deploy App, your MDM or the phones.
